title: Transcript/cwd-keyed history lanes can't aggregate worktree sessions under their base project filter
wanted_capability: Filtering cwd-keyed history by a project should match work done in every checkout of that project, including out-of-tree worktrees. bbox_search / bbox_cite / bbox_sessions_list and work_tool_calls key records by the literal session/call cwd and filter by substring, so: in-tree worktree records (.claude/worktrees/...) accidentally match a base-path filter (path containment), but out-of-tree fleet/agent worktree sessions (under $BRO_HOME/fleet|agent/worktrees) are invisible under a base filter, and a worktree-path filter sees only that one checkout. Query-time rescoping is the WRONG fix here (unlike the store surfaces fixed in 372fac2..a9eaef1): the record key is the literal cwd, and per-candidate git probes at query time are too expensive. Wanted: index-time base-project resolution — stamp each transcript/tool-call doc with a resolved base-project key (via resolve_base_project_for_scope at ingest) alongside the raw cwd, let the project filter match either, and backfill on reindex.
missing_primitive: resolved base-project field on transcript/tool-call index docs (ingest-time worktree→base resolution + reindex backfill)
fallback_used: Query with substring fragments that match both path shapes (e.g. the repo directory name), or query per-worktree-path and merge manually.
evidence: crates/bbox-indexing/src/projects.rs:513 (resolve_base_project_for_scope — the ingest-time resolver to reuse)
